run_chatbot_cli: run the fairseq2 chatbot recipe entry point that starts an interactive chat session
run_chatbot_with_model: run the chatbot CLI with a specific model name and tokenizer for inference
run_chatbot_tensor_parallel: run the chatbot with tensor parallelism across multiple GPUs for large models
run_chatbot_custom_prompt: run the chatbot CLI and provide a custom system prompt at startup
run_chatbot_with_sampling: run the chatbot with custom temperature and top-p sampling parameters for generation
